method.scope: bounded source-backed storage/port/lifecycle derivation for an already fixed question

scope.workload_window_owned_by: root and source-stripe seat; not independently repeated here

existing_semantics.claim: debug does pure translation, one active request and one overwritten MMIO response; always-ready sink
normal TC owns accepted response for its actual native Ax, forwards PA and releases at internal downstream acceptance, which may be a spill/demux
iDMA existing Ax are untranslated; changing address alone in current translated context does not implement result adoption
TL contains translated handling but gates it with EN_ATS and distinguishes T2GPA; InclATS=0 does not prove every possible trusted physical path absent
pin lease/register/adopt/last-use bridges not supplied by current IOTLB allocation-mask experiment

fields.name: source_iova
fields.recycling: retain through identity/fault last use; fixed 16384-byte length implicit

fields.name: resolved_context_key
fields.optional_removal_condition: conservative whole-pool invalidation with a complete device/process/context/invalidation bridge; same optimization for controls

fields.name: epoch_snapshot
fields.condition: wrap cannot alias a live owner/return; otherwise drain before reuse

fields.name: route
fields.definition: ceil(log2(M)) possible source/result-sink routes; fixed fault sink may be implicit; independent fault routes need extra bits

fields.name: job_generation
fields.placement: shared stripe header or managed handle
fields.condition: retired job ID may be reused only after its prior owner is done; handle does not contain result data

fields.name: stripe_state_and_release
fields.encoding: FREE/ACTIVE/FAULT/STALE in 2 bits plus application release in 1 bit

fields.name: per_page_state
fields.condition: K includes reserved/pending/ready/fault, even if status is compressed

fields.name: cursor_or_fault_ordinal
fields.recycling: same field after fault; no duplicate per-page VPN

fields.name: ready_ppns
fields.condition: reference uncompressed arbitrary 4KiB PPNs; not a net hardware/area lower bound; shared contiguous input VPNs implicit

fields.name: exact_access_permission_proof
fields.placement: READY state semantics + immutable header context/access
fields.condition: does not permit arbitrary R/W/RX reuse; broader permissions need fields/checker

fields.name: first_fault_payload
fields.placement: union with abandoned ready PPN bank
fields.condition: terminate the whole preparation stripe at first fault; retain header and ordinal; drain accepted work; not proof of a native future-fault ABI

fields.name: last_use_proof_bridge
fields.placement: native producer/consumer owner interface and any required ledger
fields.condition: current TC does not know remaining unissued parent bytes; per-page status alone is not this proof

equal_optimization_rules: first-fault whole-stripe termination and bank recycling
legitimate early unpin and last translation-use release
reclaim fields only after original owner is dead
reuse existing TC/MRIF/backend fields only with live-owner/write/port proof, equally for ordinary designs

formulas.pin_advisory_without_way_map: H+u+2*N+16+X_last+X_epoch+X_route+X_impl, plus lookup-port arbitration/service on release
formulas.same_scope_compact_endpoint_ATC: same as best_given_ordinary_one_shot when capability/lifetime equal
formulas.unshared_general_ATC_reference: 193+E+owner/ref bits per entry plus all queues/checkers; NOT a lower bound or fair direct comparison to fixed-R compact table

unknown_terms.E: epoch width requires wrap/drain contract; no arbitrary value frozen
unknown_terms.G: handle/job generation width and alias discipline not frozen
unknown_terms.W: actual route identity binding and independent fault sink paths not frozen
unknown_terms.X_last: parent progress/remaining-byte/refcount or page-last bridge; current serial TC only knows its child
unknown_terms.X_epoch: manager current epoch (at least E bits for this encoding), invalidation ingress/ack and wrap/drain state
unknown_terms.X_route: receive/response/fault sink queues and cross-boundary route state not already in H
unknown_terms.X_impl: concrete allocation/interface staging/control registers, if needed; fixed one-stripe pool has no free-list, multi-stripe reuse requires owner pointers/allocator
unknown_terms.physical_cost: constant folding, live-register reuse, LUT/FF/BRAM/Fmax/energy unknown
unknown_terms.performance: ordinary prewarm/PTE-cache residual, PLRU eviction, complete consumer critical path and service durations not established by this seat

ports.cost: CPU MMIO/polling, shared normal-priority service; external retained table not provided

ports.access: one logical lookup, one update, invalidation array control
ports.cost: pin claim/release atomic integration is proposed; no physical multiport RAM inference claimed

ports.access: prepare completion write, adopt read, release/free state write, fault/invalidation
ports.cost: 1RW serial arbitration permitted; direct always-ready debug needs reliable capture storage, no free ports

ports.access: normal lookup, atomic fill/pin, owner-specific unpin, invalidation
ports.cost: way map or extra lookup arbitration; masks/refcounts for shared owners; no accepted work without reservation

ports.organization: endpoint ATC or TC-adjacent PA table
ports.access: local match/read, result write, invalidation plus downstream ownership
ports.cost: same compact state permitted; interface/AT/trusted-path wiring and ownership changes charged

lifecycle.owner: immutable source/context/generation plus K=N result credits; pending counts
published PTE address and accepted return/error
lifecycle.release: cancel only before first offer; otherwise retire

lifecycle.owner: result identity, exact access, epoch and sink
lifecycle.release: application SPM release is a separate event

lifecycle.owner: matched actual native child and receiver capacity
lifecycle.release: gate identity/permission/epoch before physical first VALID; no held-VALID retarget

lifecycle.owner: proof no unissued parent/other owner needs mapping
lifecycle.release: free result/unpin at final translation-use handoff; no need to hold until R/B/consumer

lifecycle.owner: accepted PTEs, old references and fault sink
lifecycle.release: bank/handle reuse only after drain and identity/fault handoff

lifecycle.owner: native R/W/B, cache handoff, buffer/consumer obligations
lifecycle.release: translation release does not imply these complete

integration_alternatives.TC_adjacent_PA_result_table: same information contract as O-PAQ-D; future pure-translation entry/owner still proposed
integration_alternatives.endpoint_fixed_span_ATC: can be equally compressed; may have cheaper parent last-use visibility, but actual integration unknown
integration_alternatives.normal_physical_data_cache: helps payload service after PA is known, not automatic retention of IOVA translations
integration_alternatives.early_payload_staging: legal only with data-stability/read authority; full span needs 131072 data bits plus cache/route/completion costs; smaller prefixes permitted equally
integration_alternatives.trusted_physical_or_Bare_DID: possible alternative; full path not checked, charge independent authority/binding/switching/mapping-pin/revocation/mixed-leg costs; neither free existence nor absolute absence inferred
